result.instructions: One read-only tool: score_posting. Verdicts follow FILTER.md v1.0; INSUFFICIENT claims mean 'I cannot tell'.

tools.name: score_posting
tools.title: Score a job posting with Anisha's JS3 filter
tools.description: Scores ONE job posting for the fictional persona Nadia Okafor (entry-level data analyst, at most 3 years) with the rules in FILTER.md v1.0. Give either `id` (a posting id from the local corpus, e.g. 'greenhouse:stripe:123') or `title` + `text`. Returns the filter verdict (kept / rejected / cannot_tell), the score, the failed rules, and every justification claim labelled SUPPORTED / CONTRADICTED / INSUFFICIENT with a quote from the posting. Read-only: it does not fetch, apply or email; it appends every message to its own transcript file. Rules: R1 analyst title word, R1b no engineer title (v1.1), R2 no seniority word, R3 at least 2 of the persona's skills, R4 at most 3 years stated.

id.description: posting id from the local corpus

location.description: optional; does not affect the verdict

content.text: {"id": "greenhouse:stripe:8273713", "title": "Corporate Accounting Analyst (Bangalore)", "url": "https://stripe.com/jobs/search?gh_jid=8273713", "filter_version": "1.0", "status": "rejected", "score": 1, "failed": ["R3", "R4"], "skills_matched": ["SQL"], "years_max": 6, "shortlist": false, "why_not": "filter rejected: R3, R4", "claims": [{"claim": "is an entry-level analyst role (title)", "label": "SUPPORTED", "quote": "Corporate Accounting Analyst (Bangalore)", "say": "Supported: \"Corporate Accounting Analyst (Bangalore)\""}, {"claim": "requires SQL", "label": "INSUFFICIENT", "quote": "Hubble and SQL", "say": "I cannot tell whether the posting requires SQL: it appears only as \"Hubble and SQL\""}, {"claim": "asks for at most 3 years", "label": "CONTRADICTED", "quote": "The ideal candidate holds a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification, possesses 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience, and brings a modern, tech-enabled mindset—specifically the ability to leverage AI tools, automation, and advanced analytics to streamline workflows and solve complex accounting problems in a rapidly evolving environment.", "say": "Contradicted: \"The ideal candidate holds a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification, possesses 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience, and brings a modern, tech-enabled mindset—specifically the ability to leverage AI tools, automation, and advanced analytics to streamline workflows and solve complex accounting problems in a rapidly evolving environment.\""}]}
